In this script we explore phenotype (expression of TEs), obtained by RSEM count
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(stringr)
```
# Load data (reads with no filter, cpm normalized)
```{r}
long_data_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/sense_expr_te_genes_no_filter_reads_log2cpm_normalization.csv.gz", sep=",")
# Anti-sense TE data 
long_data_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/anti_sense_expr_te_genes_no_filter_reads_log2cpm_normalization.csv.gz", sep=",")
```

```{r}
## Get TEs expressed in ddm1 ct and in F1 ddm1
tes_expressed_constantly_ddm1_ct <- long_data_sense %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
  filter(
    genotype == c("ddm1_ct", "ddm1"),
    grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", id)   # keep only TEs
  ) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_expressed = sum(log2cpm > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    expressed_in_all = all(log2cpm > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(expressed_in_all)
```

```{r}
## Visualize this tes 
heatmap_data <- long_data_sense %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
  filter(
    id %in% tes_expressed_constantly_ddm1_ct$id
  )

mat <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(id, sample_id, log2cpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = log2cpm) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("id") %>%
  as.matrix()

Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "log2(counts)",
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  row_km = 1,
  row_km_repeats = 1000,
  column_km_repeats = 1000,
  column_km = 1,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13)))
```

## Add superfamilies 
```{r}
te_families <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", sep="\t")
```

```{r}
# Superfamily for each TE in the matrix (same order as rownames)
superfam <- te_families$Transposon_Super_Family[
  match(rownames(mat), te_families$Transposon_Name)]

Heatmap(

  row_split = superfam,                             # cluster within superfamily

## Calculate plate variation 
```{r}
plate_variation <- long_data_sense_controls %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
   filter(
    genotype == "ddm1_ct",
    grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", id)   # keep only TEs
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, plate) %>%
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(log2cpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_between_plates = sd(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_between_plates = sd_between_plates / mean(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sd_between_plates))

ggplot(plate_variation, aes(cv_between_plates)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "CV between plates", y = "Number of TEs",
       title = "Between-plate variation of TE expression (ddm1_ct)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
## Make a PCA on expressed TEs 
```{r}
plate_variation_less_than30 <- plate_variation[plate_variation$cv_between_plates<0.3,]

mat_all <- long_data_sense_controls %>%
  filter(id %in% plate_variation_less_than30$id) %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
  select(id, sample_id, log2cpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = log2cpm) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("id") %>%
  as.matrix()

pca <- prcomp(t(mat_all), scale. = FALSE)
meta <- long_data_sense_controls %>% distinct(sample_id, plate, genotype)

data.frame(pca$x[,1:2], sample_id = rownames(pca$x)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = factor(plate), shape = genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + theme_minimal()
```

## Scatterplot ddm1 vs F1 ddm1
```{r}
scatter_data <- plate_variation_less_than30 %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
  filter(Genotype %in% c("F1_ddm1", "ddm1_ct")) %>%
  group_by(id, plate, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(expr = mean(log2cpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = expr)
```

````{r}
# Filter ddm1 controls 
controls_ddm1 <- plate_variation_less_than30 %>%
  filter(Genotype %in% c("F1_ddm1", "ddm1_ct")) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, sample_id, log2cpm, Genotype, accession, plate, replicate) %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm))

f1_ddm1 <- dat %>% filter(Genotype == "F1_ddm1") %>%
  transmute(id, accession, plate, replicate, F1_sample = sample_id, F1_ddm1 = log2cpm)
ddm1_ct <- dat %>% filter(Genotype == "ddm1_ct") %>%
  transmute(id, accession, plate, replicate, ct_sample = sample_id, ddm1_ct = log2cpm)

plot_data <- inner_join(f1_ddm1, ddm1_ct, by = c("id", "accession", "plate", "replicate"))
pairs <- distinct(plot_data, F1_sample, ct_sample)




library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# threshold for "expresses less in F1" (log2 units); 0 = any decrease, 1 = 2-fold
thr <- 1

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    diff   = F1_ddm1 - ddm1_ct,
    status = case_when(
      diff <= -thr ~ "Lower in F1_ddm1",
      diff >=  thr ~ "Higher in F1_ddm1",
      TRUE         ~ "Similar"
    )
  )

# common axis range so x and y align
thr <- 1

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    diff   = F1_ddm1 - ddm1_ct,
    status = case_when(
      diff <= -thr ~ "Lower in F1_ddm1",
      diff >=  thr ~ "Higher in F1_ddm1",
      TRUE         ~ "Similar"
    )
  )

# common axis range so x and y align
lims <- range(c(plot_data$ddm1_ct, plot_data$F1_ddm1), na.rm = TRUE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  d <- filter(plot_data, F1_sample == pairs$F1_sample[i], ct_sample == pairs$ct_sample[i])
  r <- cor(d$ddm1_ct, d$F1_ddm1, use = "complete.obs")
  n_low <- sum(d$status == "Lower in F1_ddm1")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(ddm1_ct, F1_ddm1, colour = status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Lower in F1_ddm1"  = "red",
                                   "Higher in F1_ddm1" = "blue",
                                   "Similar"           = "grey70")) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste0("F1_ddm1 vs ddm1_ct (r = ", round(r, 2), ")"),
         subtitle = paste0("F1: ", pairs$F1_sample[i], " | ddm1_ct: ", pairs$ct_sample[i],
                           "\nlower in F1 (>= ", thr, " log2): ", n_low, " TEs"),
         x = "ddm1_ct log2CPM", y = "F1_ddm1 log2CPM", colour = NULL)

  print(p)
}
```
## Check if these TEs form a unit 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# one set of TE ids per comparison
lower_sets <- lower_in_F1 %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(F1_sample, ct_sample, sep = " vs ")) %>%
  { split(.$id, .$comparison) }

lengths(lower_sets)   # set sizes")


te_recurrence <- lower_in_F1 %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(F1_sample, ct_sample, sep = " vs ")) %>%
  distinct(id, comparison) %>%
  count(id, name = "n_comparisons") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_comparisons))

# how many TEs are shared by 1, 2, 3 ... comparisons
count(te_recurrence, n_comparisons)

# core set: lower in F1 in every comparison
core_TEs <- filter(te_recurrence, n_comparisons == length(lower_sets))$id
```

## How many TEs lower than ddm1ct we have for each F1 
```{r}
# Get constantly expressed TEs 
long_data_sense_te <- long_data_sense %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(log2cpm)) %>%
  filter(
    grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", id)   # keep only TEs
  )

f1_ddm1 <- long_data_sense_te %>%
  filter(Genotype == "F1_ddm1") %>%
  transmute(id, accession, plate, replicate,
            F1_sample = sample_id,
            F1_ddm1 = as.numeric(as.character(log2cpm)))

ddm1_ct_ref <- long_data_sense_te %>%
  filter(Genotype == "ddm1_ct") %>%
  mutate(log2cpm = as.numeric(as.character(log2cpm))) %>%
  group_by(id, plate, replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ddm1_ct_ref = mean(log2cpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

plot_data <- f1_ddm1 %>%
  inner_join(ddm1_ct_ref, by = c("id", "plate", "replicate")) %>%
  mutate(
    F1_ddm1     = as.numeric(F1_ddm1),
    ddm1_ct_ref = as.numeric(ddm1_ct_ref),
    diff        = F1_ddm1 - ddm1_ct_ref
  )

```
## The most re-silenced TEs 
```{r}
# Heatmap based on the difference
library(dplyr)

acc_means <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(id, accession) %>%
  summarise(diff_acc = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop")

te_variability <- acc_means %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_acc      = n_distinct(accession),
    mean_diff  = mean(diff_acc),
    sd_diff    = sd(diff_acc),
    range_diff = max(diff_acc) - min(diff_acc),
    min_acc    = accession[which.min(diff_acc)],
    max_acc    = accession[which.max(diff_acc)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_acc >= 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(range_diff))

head(te_variability, 30)
```

```{r}
top_ids <- head(te_variability$id, 100)

mat <- acc_means %>%
  filter(id %in% top_ids) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = id, names_from = accession, values_from = diff_acc) %>%
 column_to_rownames("id") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat <- mat[complete.cases(mat), , drop = FALSE]

Heatmap(mat, name = "F1 - ddm1_ct",
        col = colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("blue", "white", "red")),
        row_km = 1, show_row_names = nrow(mat) <= 60,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
```
